segments.ja290:1.1: Sīlaṃ kireva kalyāṇaṃ, sīlaṃ loke anuttaraṃ;
segments.ja290:1.3: Passa ghoraviso nāgo, sīlavāti na haññati.
segments.ja290:2.1: Sohaṃ sīlaṃ samādissaṃ, loke anumataṃ sivaṃ;
segments.ja290:3.1: Ñātīnañca piyo hoti, mittesu ca virocati;
segments.ja290:6.3: Anusāsaniyopi ca macchavaro, maṇikuṇḍalakena kirena dasāti.

lines: Kalyāṇanti sobhanaṃ,“sīlaṃ kireva kalyāṇan”ti evaṃ paṇḍitā vadantīti attho.
Na haññatīti parampi na viheṭheti, parehipi na viheṭhīyati.
Yena vuccatīti yena sīlena sīlavā puriso ariyānaṃ buddhādīnaṃ paṭipattiṃ samācaranto “ariyavuttisamācāro”ti vuccati, tamahaṃ samādiyissāmīti attho.
